title: PR body verification counts are stale: says render suite 56/56 with '4 font pins', actual suite is 57 tests with 5 pins
evidence: _pr_body_font_overhaul.md line 48: "Harness 48/48 green on the re-blessed goldens; render suite 56/56 (incl. the 4 font pins); core 236/236." — app/render/font_test.odin declares five pins: "font_warning_glyph_in_merged_atlas :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {", "font_warning_glyph_negative_control :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {", "font_guard_reports_missing_asset :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {", "font_mono_tabular_digits :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {", "font_text_contrast_pin :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {". Running `odin test app/render` finishes "57 tests ... All tests were successful."
detail: The PR body is the spec's designated proof vehicle (rule 5: hash-equal proof in PR body) but was not updated after the r4 round added font_text_contrast_pin. All claims verified true except these two counts.
recommended_fix: Update _pr_body_font_overhaul.md line 48 to "render suite 57/57 (incl. the 5 font pins)".
